name: Dizzy
summary: Generator that built fully styled, customizable shadcn-based sites; the free service is retiring.
description: Dizzy generated fully styled, deeply customizable shadcn-based sites in minutes, letting you tune fonts, colors, spacing, radii, depth, shadows and subtle animations so the result felt like your own design system rather than a template. It was free from day one; the author is retiring the service and asks whether there is interest in a paid rebuild ($99/year for unlimited generations).
contains: controls for fonts, depth, shadows, spacing, radii and animations
retiring: gauging interest in a $99/year rebuild
